name: event-log
description: The raw record of a session: every event that crosses Claude Code, whoever raised it (you, the model, the engine, settings hooks, plugins), with its full payload to ~/.claude/event-log/<session>/NNNN.jsonl, and a peek per event in a live pane. agent-log is the interpreted view. /eventlog toggles it, /eventlog <you|claude|engine|hook|plugin|all> filters by who.

maxMB.title: Log size cap (MB)
maxMB.description: Per session: past it the log stops writing to disk, and the pane says so
